text:
ana: dropping a fresh mock for the compact scorecard approval flow. goal: make regressions scannable and reduce accidental approves. link: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/compact-scorecard-v3.png

matt: quick summary?

ana: short: 1) collapsed per-test rows with a single-line regression preview, 2) sticky actions bar with primary on the right, 3) inline confidence chips, 4) screenreader announce for expand and for final approval toast.

elaine: collapsed rows look much cleaner. for keyboard users, how do we handle expand + focus when they press Enter on a row?

ana: plan: row is a button with `aria-expanded`, Enter toggles expansion and moves focus to first interactive inside expanded panel (comment input). we'll add `role=region` with `aria-label="Test details"` and focus management.

sam: a11y nit: when expanding, also populate an `aria-live="polite"` node: "Details opened for <test name>, 2 diffs, 1 regression" so screenreaders get context.

matt: microcopy: collapsed preview shows `+2 regressions` in red. should it be `2 regressions` or `+2`? plus sounds like new regressions.

ana: yeah `+2 regressions` -> implies new. we'll keep plus for new/regression count, plain number for total errors. add tooltip text on hover.

elaine: sticky actions: show "Approve selected (n)" when items checked, otherwise "Approve run". but if sticky is always visible, ensure tabbable order remains intuitive.

sam: recommend sticky always visible but `aria-disabled="true"` and `title` explaining why when nothing selected. stable layout helps muscle memory.

ana: toast behavior: after approve show toast: "Approved 3 tests. Undo" in a `role=status` container so it's announced. Undo should be reachable via keyboard and restore previous selection/focus.

matt: analytics: track `scorecard.approve_run`, `scorecard.approve_selection`, `scorecard.undo_approve`. include `selected_count` and `time_to_approve_ms`.

ana: color contrast: aria_bot flagged primary blue (#2570F6) below 4.5:1 on white. suggested #0F4CD0 or darken CTA. I'll update palette.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: suggested CTA contrast #0F4CD0 => 4.6:1. Also suggest 2px focus ring with `outline-offset: 2px`.

elaine: compact mode question: do we show comment preview inline? might make rows taller. maybe show one-line truncated comment with `aria-hidden` on overflow and full comment in expansion.

ana: agree, keep collapsed compact: show name | status badge | regression badge | one-line summary (truncate with ellipsis). full comment only in expansion.

sam: keyboard shortcut idea: `Shift+A` to approve selected, `U` to undo last approve (with confirmation if > 10 items). document in keyboard shortcuts modal.

matt: dev question: how do we surface which tests changed since last run? tiny green `+` for new passes, red `+` for new regressions. keep legend in header.

ana: action items: (ana) update mock w/ contrast + tooltip + truncated comment (2199998896), (sam) implement `role=region` + `aria-live` for expansion and ensure focus restore, (elaine) verify keyboard tab order and add shortcut discoverability in the modal. (matt) add analytics event enums.

ana: thanks all, will post updated PNG and include a small prototype HTML snippet in the PR for screenreader testing. :thumbsup:
